title: Public Tenders - UK and EU Official APIs

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Official adapters, queried serially in round-robin order.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Match ANY phrase, case insensitive, in normalized title, description or buyer. Applied before saving.

publishedFrom.title: Published from
publishedFrom.description: Inclusive UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to seven days ago.

publishedTo.title: Published to
publishedTo.description: Inclusive UTC date, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today.

cpvCodes.title: CPV codes
cpvCodes.description: Match ANY 2-8 digit prefix or full CPV code. Applied locally across all sources.

minimumValue.title: Minimum estimated value
minimumValue.description: Inclusive numeric threshold. Requires valueCurrency when positive; unknown estimates are excluded. No currency conversion.

valueCurrency.title: Value currency
valueCurrency.description: Optional three-letter currency filter, required for a positive minimumValue.

maxResults.title: Maximum results
maxResults.description: Global unique matching notice cap across sources.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Maximum upstream page size. Sources share the remaining result budget.

requestDelaySeconds.title: Request interval
requestDelaySeconds.description: Minimum seconds between serial requests, including retries.

maxPages.title: Maximum pages
maxPages.description: Safety bound on source pages scanned. Filters can result in fewer saved items.
